name: certora-autoprover-soroban
description: End-to-end formal verification of a Soroban contract with the Certora Soroban Prover. Given a Rust contract crate on soroban-sdk 22 or 25, this skill analyzes the contract's functions and storage, scaffolds a CVLR harness into the crate behind a cargo feature, formulates security properties (invariants, safety properties, attack vectors) per component, formalizes them as CVLR rules, and iterates the prover until every rule is verified, excused as a suspected bug, or skipped with justification — ending with a verification report.
